heading: This Afternoon
text: Partly to mostly cloudy. Highs from the mid 40s to around 50, except low to mid 50s in southeastern valleys and in the Hudson Valley. West to northwest winds 5 to 10 mph, gusting to 20 mph east of the Greens.

heading: Tonight
text: Mostly cloudy. Chance of rain or snow showers from New York into southwestern Vermont late. Lows in the upper 20s to lower 30s east, low to mid 30s west. Winds diminishing to light and variable.

heading: Thursday
text: Cloudy. Rain likely in the valleys south and west of Interstate 89, a rising chance north and east, reaching the Northeast Kingdom and northern New Hampshire in the afternoon; rain mixing with or changing to snow over high terrain, with a trace to 2 inches, mainly in the Adirondacks and southern Greens. Valley highs from the upper 30s to mid 40s. East to northeast winds 5 to 10 mph.
